newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen steady to higher, much data looms.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen steady to higher, much data looms.

text.p: A firm U.S. Treasury market and a stronger dollar were expected to lend strength to stocks at Monday's open but the day's outlook may hinge on release of the first figures in an unusually heavy week-long calendar of economic data.

Pro-dollar comments at the weekend meeting of the Group of Seven countries in Washington helped trigger a sharp dollar rally in Europe. Treasuries also opened firmer ahead of the release of income and spending reports in the U.S.
